name: EventPro Software
description_en:
EventPro Software manages venue bookings, event planning and catering through configurable modules. It connects rooms, resources, staffing, clients, itineraries, invoices and budgets. EPConnect adds customer-facing booking or attendee-registration workflows; its presence should not be interpreted as an automatic entitlement in every installation.

Unlike a cloud-only ticketing page, EventPro explicitly offers cloud delivery and on-premise desktop/network installation. The choice changes maintenance, connectivity and local IT responsibilities, while the vendor describes the same core functional toolset. This profile concerns EventPro from Profit Systems, not similarly named event services.
description_zh:
EventPro Software 通过可配置模块管理场地预订、活动规划和餐饮，关联房间、资源、员工、客户、行程、发票及预算。EPConnect 增加对客预订或参与者报名，但不能据此推断所有安装都默认包含。

EventPro 明确同时提供云交付及本地桌面/网络安装，部署选择改变维护、联网和 IT 责任，厂商则称核心工具相同。本文指 Profit Systems 的 EventPro，不是其他同名活动服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate bookable spaces, resources and staffing against bookings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 围绕预订协调场地、资源与员工。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose managed remote delivery or internally installed desktop/network software.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择托管远程交付或内部安装的桌面/网络软件。

en: Manage a venue reception with rooms, resources, catering and invoice reconciliation.
zh: 管理招待会的房间、资源、餐饮与发票核对。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Select cloud or on-premise, identify required modules and validate a representative booking with the intended IT and finance owners.
steps.zh: 选择云或本地、明确模块，并由 IT 与财务负责人核对代表性预订。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Configured software/deployment package and optional modules/services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Custom quote based on modules, users, rooms, deployment and training. No standard amount, free production entitlement, perpetual-license right or upgrade inclusion was verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按模块、用户、房间、部署和培训询价，未核实标准金额、免费生产权益、永久许可或升级包含范围。

sources.title: Venue Management Software | EventPro
sources.research_notes_en: EventPro Software by Profit Systems, modular venue/event/catering operations; EPConnect online registration/booking distinct.

sources.title: On Prem Software | EventPro
sources.research_notes_en: Cloud delivered through Citrix with dedicated customer databases, or on-prem desktop/network installed and maintained by customer.

sources.title: EventPro Software Pricing for your needs
sources.research_notes_en: Custom purchase based on modules, users, rooms and training, no public amount.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow a booking beyond its calendar block
sections.title_zh: 沿日历预订核对后续运营
sections.en: A venue booking can carry room allocation, catering, beverages, staffing, equipment, pricing and invoicing. For an illustrative reception, reserve the room and setup window, assign tables and staff, and compare the invoice with the agreed package. Confirm which optional modules are purchased before relying on online attendee registration, floor plans or exhibitor management. A calendar entry alone does not validate resource availability or financial accuracy.
sections.zh: 场地预订可关联房间、餐饮、饮品、员工、设备、价格与发票。例如招待会，应预留场地及搭建时间、分配桌椅员工，再把发票与约定套餐核对。依赖在线报名、平面图或展商管理前，要确认选购模块。一个日历块不能证明资源可用或账务准确。

sections.title_en: Cloud access uses a remote-delivery architecture
sections.title_zh: 云访问采用远程交付架构
sections.en: The deployment page says EventPro Cloud uses Citrix and a dedicated database per client, with access to local drives and printers. It is not evidence of a native application on every listed device. On-premise requires installation, manual updates and internal security/backup ownership; most core features are described as usable through an internet outage. External online services still need their own connectivity check.
sections.zh: 部署页称 EventPro Cloud 使用 Citrix，每客户独立数据库，可访问本地磁盘和打印机；这不能证明每种列出设备都有原生应用。本地部署需安装、手动更新并负责内部安全和备份，文档称大多数核心功能可在断网时使用，但外部在线服务仍需单独检查网络依赖。

sections.title_en: Scope modules, users, rooms and training
sections.title_zh: 按模块、用户、房间及培训定范围
sections.en: The pricing page offers a needs assessment rather than a standard amount. Optional modules, number of users and rooms, software training and purchase options affect price. Ask for the hosting model, EPConnect entitlement, implementation and ongoing upgrade/support contract in the quote. A local installation is not proof of open-source rights, a perpetual license or free upgrades.
sections.zh: 定价页提供需求评估，不公布标准金额。模块、用户数、房间数、培训及购买方式影响价格。报价中应明确托管方式、EPConnect 权益、实施和持续升级/支持合同。本地安装不证明开源权利、永久许可或免费升级。

sections.title_en: Match the operational burden to the deployment
sections.title_zh: 让运营负担与部署方式匹配
sections.en: EventPro merits investigation for venues or catering/event businesses needing integrated resources and finance. A simple RSVP list may not justify this setup. Pilot one booking change, invoice correction, printer workflow and role restriction before rollout. No desktop installation, Citrix session, outage, restoration or payment was tested. Exact system requirements, residency, license terms and backup recovery remain gaps.
sections.zh: 需要资源与财务一体化的场地、餐饮或活动业务可研究 EventPro，简单 RSVP 名单未必需要这套配置。推广前应试验预订变更、发票修订、打印与角色限制。本文未测试桌面安装、Citrix 会话、断网、恢复或支付，准确系统要求、存储地区、许可及备份恢复仍有缺口。

research_gaps: No installation, Citrix access, booking, EPConnect, invoice, printer or recovery was tested.
Current OS/server requirements, module entitlements, license terms, purchase amounts, upgrade contract and recovery/residency require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
